P.name: Blade's End
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Talon's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Wound'' to enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on basic attacks and subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
P.description2: '''Talon's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} against an enemy with 3 ''Wound'' stacks is empowered to consume them all to cause the target to bleed, dealing{{ft|{{as|{{pp|80 + (280-80)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 210% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}|{{as|{{pp|80/16 + (280/16-80/16)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|210/16}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds}}over 2 seconds. The target cannot gain ''Wound'' stacks during this time.

Q.name: Noxian Diplomacy
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' {{tip|dashes}} toward the target enemy, stabbing the target upon arrival to deal {{as|physical damage}}. If cast within close range, '''Talon''' {{tt|{{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target|to within 150 units, if Talon is not closer already}} over the cast time instead and ''Noxian Diplomacy'' {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|100}}|critical damage}} damage, as well as grants him {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}} on his next basic attack within 1 second.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|65 to 145}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Critical Physical Damage|{{ap|65*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: If ''Noxian Diplomacy'' kills the target, '''Talon''' {{tip|heals}} for {{pp|9 + (55-9)*(x-1)/17|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}} and the ability's {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 50%.
Q.description3: ''Noxian Diplomacy {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Talon's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Shadow Assault|Talon}} can be cast during the dash.''
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|None|Ranged dash attack}}|{{tt|{{as|100% of '''Talon's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|(1/{{ccd|Talon|as_base}})*{{ccd|Talon|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})|Close dash attack}}}}

W.name: Rake
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' throws a fan of daggers in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
W.description2: At maximum range, the daggers linger for {{fd|0.7}} seconds before homing back to '''Talon''', dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 1 second.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|50+60 to 90+180}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40+90}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
W.description3: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

E.name: Assassin's Path
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' {{tip|dashes}} up to 800 units over the target area of [[terrain]] while within proximity of it, during which he gains {{tip|unobstructed vision}}.
E.description2: '''Talon''' cannot cast ''Assassin's Path'' on the same area of terrain for a set duration.
E.description3: ''{{ai|Shadow Assault|Talon}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Shadow Assault
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Talon''' disperses a ring of blades around him that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and lingers at maximum range for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds, during which he gains {{tip|invisibility}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|90 to 180}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 70}}%}}
R.description2: ''Shadow Assault'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or if '''Talon''' {{tip|breaks stealth}}.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Talon''' breaks stealth and converges the blades to him, dealing the same {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Breaking stealth with a basic attack or ''{{ai|Noxian Diplomacy|Talon}}'' will converge the blades to the target instead.
